name: Tilly Brook
description: Plaits and a missing front tooth. Stands on tiptoe to see over the counter.

visits.greeting: Hello! Are you the curator? Do you have magic tricks? Real ones?

request.text: Tricks for the Parlour! For my friends. It's my birthday on Sunday.

readThoughts.default: A coin behind Pip's ear. Pip laughing.

purpose.2: Tricks! The coin one. And the birds. My brother Pip says I can't.

experience.2: I can hang a spoon off my nose. That's not magic. That's practice.

lent.line: Thank you thank you thank you! I'll bring it back!

alternative.line: Is this one magic too? Okay!

mixedAccident.text: Did you hear? The Brook boy wore a cat's face for a whole afternoon, whiskers and all. His mother says he cried when it wore off — he wanted to keep it.
